name: bulk-pagespeed-checker
title: Core Web Vitals for Every Page in Your Sitemap, as CSV
description: Core Web Vitals for every page in your sitemap, as CSV. Give a list of URLs (the Sitemap URL Extractor can list a site's URLs first) and get Lighthouse category scores, lab metrics and, when Google has them, real-user Core Web Vitals for mobile and desktop. Uses only the official Google PageSpeed Insights API v5. Export CSV, Excel or JSON.
seoTitle: Bulk Core Web Vitals Checker: PageSpeed to CSV
seoDescription: Core Web Vitals and PageSpeed scores for many URLs, mobile and desktop, exported as CSV. Uses the official Google PageSpeed Insights API.
